display_long_description:
Get ready, thieves, a big break-in just got bigger! The new Mega Update has arrived and with it, our biggest update yet!

・The house is getting a renovation, unlocking brand-new areas to sneak through (did someone say attic?! 👀)
・A new family member, the Daughter is here! It looks like she has some "Little Requests" for you?
・The pinnacle of thievery, the Ultimate Gear Thief Tool is here to help you snag all this new loot and avoid detection!

With this update, Little Thief isn’t looking so “little” anymore!

💰Steal from the Rich, Become a VR Robin Hood!💰
 Little Thief is a thrilling VR game where you sneak into wealthy homes, stealing anything you can grab—over 400 unique items! But choose wisely: your backpack space is limited. Select carefully, steal boldly!

🎒Prank the Homeowner, Escape the Police!🎒
 Use items and your environment to set mischievous traps for unsuspecting homeowners. But watch out—if you're caught, they'll call the police, and you'll be forced to make a daring escape!

🔫 Unlock Your Thieves Tools with Stolen Goods! 🔫
 From portraits and jewels to even the homeowner's gold teeth, steal valuable items and cash them in for advanced burglary tools. Unlock new possibilities to enter previously inaccessible areas and snatch even greater treasures!
